# A test picks a typed select by the value it holds where the select is no
# simple node of the component. Without `:value`, passImplicitState wraps the
# select, and the wrapper's splice copied its trigger with a fresh handle, so
# test reach did not find the copy, restored the event, and handed fyne's
# invoker an int where it takes a label: the test did not compile
# (FuncLowering.CopyOf, keptCopies). One copy of a loop's is reached through
# the copy's instance, `c.pick__state[1]` (nameInstance). Where a test still
# cannot reach the node -- a copy bubbletea spliced into each element, a select
# inside an instance a loop builds -- the build says so, naming #318, where the
# invoker chose nothing or did not compile. android's test raises the event
# with the value itself (valueTriggers), so only the nested case, through one
# copy of a loop's, is refused there.

sngl test --platform=none unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none loop.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html loop.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

! sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go nested.sngl
stderr 'nested.sngl:31:21: the test raises `change` through the target''s override of the event.*#318'

! sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin nested.sngl
stderr 'nested.sngl:31:21: the test raises `change` through the target''s override of the event.*#318'
-- unbound.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var log = ""
    ui.select #pick(@change(v) { log = "{v}" }) {
        ui.choice(label="One", value=1)
        ui.choice(label="Two", value=2)
    }
}

func testUnbound(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.pick.change(2)
    t.assert(c.log == "2")
}

ui.window {
    main()
}
-- loop.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var items = ["a", "b"]
    var log = ""
    ui.vbox {
        for var it = items {
            ui.select #pick(@change(v) { log = "{it}={v}" }) {
                ui.choice(label="One", value=1)
                ui.choice(label="Two", value=2)
            }
        }
        ui.text(value=log)
    }
}

func testSecondCopy(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.pick[1].change(2)
    t.assert(c.log == "b=2")
}

ui.window {
    main()
}
-- nested.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component branch(label string) ui.node {
    var on = true
    var pick = 1

    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value=label)
        if on {
            ui.select #size(:value=pick) {
                ui.choice(label="Small", value=1)
                ui.choice(label="Large", value=2)
            }
        }
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var names = ["a", "b"]
    for var n = names {
        branch #row(label=n)
    }
}

func testSecondRow(t test.Test, c main) {
    var r = c.row[1]
    if r != null {
        var s = r.size
        if s != null {
            s.change(2)
        }
        t.assert(r.pick == 2)
    }
    var r0 = c.row[0]
    if r0 != null {
        t.assert(r0.pick == 1)
    }
}

ui.window {
    main()
}
